title: Fourth Round of US-Backed Government–Opposition Talks Opens in Caracas
detail: A fourth round of US-backed talks between Venezuela's acting government (led by Jorge Rodríguez) and the opposition's 2015 National Assembly delegation (led by Dinorah Figuera) opened on Nov 13, 2026 at a Caracas hotel, closed to the press. The agenda includes a new Supreme Court, a new electoral council (CNE), laws used to bar candidates, and possibly political prisoners; the round is expected to last about a week.

media.caption: Fourth round of talks opens in Caracas
